note: Signed for 'now': run every case with the clock set to it. Conformance vectors run in order against one freshly started bridge configured with 'env', 'manifest_b64' (the committed atrium-bridge.json) and 'panel_js_b64' (the widget it serves). Bodies are base64 (standard alphabet, padded), except a conformance step's 'body_b64': base64url without padding, as on the wire.

ping and describe answer with the approved manifest
